frozen_at: 2026-10-28, before any fresh600 run of these arms (3-task smoke tests only)
baseline: WorldEvolver-style selective foresight (arXiv 2606.30639): the world model predicts the next observation of the planner's proposed action at EVERY step; the prediction is shown only if its confidence exp(mean token logprob) > tau; when the gate is closed the planner is called again without foresight (WorldEvolver Alg. 1, CC)

variants.selective_em: online episodic memory of real transitions (k=5 Jaccard retrieval, as in round 1/2), built during evaluation

alignment: same planners (4B, 14B), world model = the same frozen Qwen3-14B (wm_alt) as every other arm, protocol v2-list, fresh600 x 3

tau.calibration: 30% target usage on label-pool states of each planner (tables/selective_calibration.json); test data not used

deviations: WorldEvolver's semantic heuristic rules are not included
memory retrieval as implemented in round 1 (action-word Jaccard)
hardware: NPU 0-3 only (1 x 4B, 3 x 14B); NPU 4-7 left free
test: paired task bootstrap 20k on rep-averaged per-task values, two-sided, Holm within each planner (2 contrasts); non-inferiority margin -2 pp also reported
